findings.body:
43y's [A4] asks for a real hn6-style cloud epic run on pi-durable. Only the local half is observed (docs/pi-durable-local-epic-run-2026-10-05.md, tick qdg). The cloud half can only run once main carries the epic and the factory has deployed it, so today it is predicted, owned by docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md (tick kkt) with the operator named as owner, and no tick holds it. Run it per the runbook after `ticfac factory wait-deployed <merge sha>` and record it beside qdg's doc. It spends money on the live factory, so the operator starts it. Pair it with the [A2] fault injections, the next finding, in one run.
evidence: docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:64 (what 'observed' means for [A4]'s cloud half); docs/pi-durable-local-epic-run-2026-10-05.md:86 ('[A4] is half-met until the post-merge cloud run executes')
findings.title: Post-merge cloud epic run on pi-durable to observe 43y's [A4] cloud half

findings.body:
[A2] says 'proven on staging and in a real run'. Staging is observed (harness/proof/README.md, the jpy pass, 493 s). The real-run half has never been recorded: the epic note from ewd (2026-10-05 21:08) scores it predicted, with the runbook as owner. In the post-merge cloud run, fire one factory deploy mid-tool and delete one attempt container by exact name mid-turn, then check the ticfac-harness log lines the runbook pins (internal/cli/runbook_fault_evidence_test.go). This is the operator's to start: it touches the live factory.
evidence: docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:87-192 (the two faults, their observation criteria, the recording step)
findings.title: Inject [A2]'s two faults into that cloud run and record them

findings.body:
[A1] says every worker, implement and role jobs, local and cloud, runs on pi-durable. The cloud PR-review boot still runs omp on GLM: reviewHarness() drops pi-durable and pi and falls back to omp. Its exception was written onto 43y's notes for worker 8em (2026-10-05 18:25), and no amendment record or operator commit confirms it, because .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/amendments/ does not exist. Either the operator confirms the exception on the record, or the review conversation moves onto a hosted WorkerAgent (a review boot/finish contract in the image, the supervisor routed off the CLI floor).
evidence: cloudflare/src/worker-boot.ts:504 (REVIEW_DEFAULT_HARNESS = "omp"), :529 (NOT_A_REVIEW_HARNESS); .tick/issues/43y.json notes 2026-10-05 18:25
findings.title: Host the cloud PR-review boot on pi-durable, or operator confirms its omp floor

findings.body:
Precondition 3 of the runbook says the factory cannot push or open PRs for this repository 'until the GitHub App rung lands (epic dm6)'. The App rung shipped in #115 and #116 (cloudflare/src/github-app.ts, the manifest flow, per-run installation tokens). Only lej, the upstream credential-ownership contract re-cut, keeps dm6 open. An operator reading the runbook would wrongly believe a cloud run of this repository is impossible, or point the run at a scratch repo. The precondition should read: `ticfac factory status` (or doctor) names the App rung live and installed on this repository.
evidence: docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:41-45; git log origin/main --grep dm6 (b45e0f8f5, 6a09b7a8b)
findings.title: Cloud-run runbook says forge access waits on dm6, but the App rung shipped

findings.body:
The harness package 43y created runs lint, typecheck and tests in CI (ci.yml 'harness conformance and replay'), but the per-tick gate's ts cell is cloudflare format, lint, contracts and tsc only. So a tick could merge with the harness suite red. One test's timeout bound (dumb-git-origin under the 300 s discipline guard) was found red at base by five workers and absorbed five times (h3c, 7oy, 4ao, omq, 30e). Add the harness suite to [testing.commands], or at least its fast half, and measure its wall time against the gate bound first, as t8u's tc9 asks for cloudflare vitest.
evidence: .tick/runners.toml:220 (ts command); .github/workflows/ci.yml:410-412
findings.title: Put the harness package's suites in the per-tick gate

findings.body:
Twice in 43y the integrated per-tick gate stayed green while CI on epic/43y went red on a shorttest.EndToEnd test. enb: seven reconcile e2e fixtures still declared cloud runner pi after twa. 4w7: the classification pin was stale after 7sn's profile edit. Each red sat until a final review read CI hours later and absorbed it after the review, costing a review round each time. The run already reads CI on main and at the close-out. Reading the epic branch's CI for each integrated code commit, and absorbing a red as a finding at once, would catch the next one at the tick that caused it. 3sd is the narrow fix for one of the two shapes.
evidence: .tick/issues/66a.json and .tick/issues/o68.json notes (enb, 4w7 absorptions); CI runs 37380024533, 37378487207, 37376277849 (red, epic head)
findings.title: Read epic-head CI after each integration, not first at the review

findings.body:
The tick asks for the next feasible epic. hn6 is already running locally, so it is not available. umq's remaining dax changes the container path and deletes the rollout grace period the runbook's deploy fault relies on, so it is a poor host for the demonstration. Proposal: a small epic of GLM-suitable 43y backlog ticks (3sd, 8wa, 2p3, 96s, q6z, gzw, qzg), planned with [A<n>] items and a command per item, run with `ticfac run <id> --cloud` after the 43y deploy. One cloud run then observes 43y's [A4] cloud half and [A2] real-run faults, and dha's u9h gate run too if the Workflow is restarted mid-run. u9h's only open blocker is the yoh epic record, whose 25 ticks are all closed. Precondition: the GitHub App rung live for this repository.
evidence: git log -1 origin/epic/hn6 (hn6 gating qjl); .tick/issues/u9h.json (blocked_by yoh only open); docs/pi-durable-cloud-run-runbook.md:47-62
findings.title: Next epic: bundle small 43y follow-ups and run it in the cloud as the A4/A2 run

response.summary: [A4] cloud half and [A2] real-run half are predicted (they wait on a post-merge cloud run the operator must start); the cloud PR-review omp exception to [A1] is unconfirmed by the operator
